newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta insurance firm 1996 profits rise 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malta insurance firm 1996 profits rise 14 pct.

text.p: Malta's Middle Sea insurance group made a pre-tax profit of 1.72 million Malta pounds ($4.48 million) for the financial year ending December 1996, an increase of 14 percent over the previous year.
Group chairman Mario Grech said earnings per share rose to 10.2 cents from 8.3 cents and the net asset value increased to 1.20 pounds from 1.12 pounds per share.

"This latter increase resulted from the retained profits generated by the group, unrealised capital gains registered on investments and the group's share of the increase in the business in force valuation of the associate company Middle Sea Valletta Life Assurance Co Ltd," he said.
Total group assets expanded by six percent to 31.11 million pounds and shareholders' funds showed a seven percent increase to 15.01 million pounds.
The board was recommending a gross dividend of six cents per share, yielding a 12 percent return on the nominal value of the shares.
Grech said the company was at an advanced stage of negotiations to enter the Belgian insurance market. No further details were immediately available.
